The '''T-P-C4 Live Organism Comfort Conveyor''' was medium-sized box designed to carry small organisms during interstellar journeys. The conveyor came in three different sizes.<ref name="GFT" />

[[Teela Panjarra]] was kept in one by [[Chief Scientist/Legends|Chief Scientist]] [[Frexton]] at the [[Corulag Academy]].
